test_Gemma3ProcessorTest: test the Gemma3ProcessorTest class which tests the Gemma3Processor functionality
test_Gemma3ProcessorTest_get_num_vision_: test the _get_num_multimodal_tokens helper method used internally in vLLM for computing vision token counts
test_Gemma3ProcessorTest_pan_and_scan: test the processor with pan_and_scan enabled to crop and process images into base plus multiple crops
test_Gemma3ProcessorTest_text_with_image: test the processor handles text with single, multiple, and no image tokens with nested image inputs
test_Gemma3ProcessorTest_special_mm_toke: test that special multimodal tokens are not truncated when truncation is enabled with a small max_length
